from pathlib import Path
fd = int(os.environ['ORZE_ACTION_INPUT_FD'])
data = json.loads(os.pread(fd, 65536, 0))
stat = Path('/proc/self/stat').read_text()

    stream.flush()

raise SystemExit(data['exit_code'])
